{{Quote|I think it strange for the Office of Ethics to be so capitulating to the so-called 'alarmists in the popular press.' Surely, the 'ethical' thing to do is foment peace with whomever we can. We see this report as a positive step toward normalizing relations with the Empire, once this has all blown over.|The Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
The '''Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] civil servant who was the head of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]'s [[Office of Extraplanetary Relations]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|This whole thing has gotten way too political. Now it's just a bunch of director-level bureaucrats passive-aggressively arguing with each other. I think one started talking about civil war? Ugh! This report is more trouble than its worth.|[[Go Kila]], to [[Hu Joomi]]|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
During the [[Invasion of Manaan]] they were sent a message from the [[Director of the Office of Ethics]] concerning a report that the Office of Extraplanetary Relations had received about untapped [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] reserves found by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and urging them to not talk about the report lest it get leaked to the press. The director ignored the Office of Ethics' director, and sent their own office-wide message stating that they welcomed the Sith, and saw it as a step towards improving relations with them.<ref name="TOR:MtN"/>
